ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA sub-question 1
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In 2010, the population densities of Shanghai's inner suburbs and outer suburbs were respectively 4684 people per square kilometer and 1388 people per square kilometer, increasing by 80.2% and 61.4% respectively compared with 2000; the increase in suburban population density was far higher than that in the urban area. Answer the question in combination with the figure below. <image1> According to the changes in the proportions of manufacturing output value in Shanghai's suburbs and urban areas from 1978 to 2009 and the changes in population spatial concentration in the past ten years, it can show that part of suburban agricultural land was transformed into what land use (corresponding to industrial development)?

matched_variant_raw.title: GeoSQA sub-question 1

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is 1978, 2004, and 2009, and the vertical axis is the proportion of manufacturing output value. The line corresponding to the suburbs rises obviously from a relatively low level in 1978, and is at a very high proportion in 2004 and 2009; the line corresponding to the urban area drops obviously from a relatively high level in 1978, and drops to a relatively low proportion in 2004 and 2009. That is to say, from 1978 to 2009, the proportion of Shanghai's manufacturing output value showed opposite changes of a large rise in the suburbs and a large decline in the urban area. The suburbs originally had more agricultural land, so this change can show that part of the suburban agricultural land was transformed into industrial land.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中郊区与城区制造业产值比重的反向变化：郊区大幅上升、城区大幅下降。再结合题干要求“对应工业发展”，判断制造业向郊区转移和集聚需要工业厂房、工业园区等建设用地。由于郊区原本农业用地较多，因此可显示郊区农业用地部分转变为工业用地。
method.CoT_raw:

raw_record.original_question:
2010年，上海市近郊区与远郊区人口密度分别为每平方千米4684人和1388人，比2000年分别增长80.2%和61.4%，郊区人口密度增幅远高于城区。结合下图回答问题。

<image1>

根据1978年到2009年上海市郊区和城区制造业产值比重的变化以及近十年人口空间集聚的变化，可以显示郊区农业用地部分转变为什么用地（对应工业发展）？
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is 1978, 2004, and 2009, and the vertical axis is the proportion of manufacturing output value. The line corresponding to the suburbs rises obviously from a relatively low level in 1978, and is at a very high proportion in 2004 and 2009; the line corresponding to the urban area drops obviously from a relatively high level in 1978, and drops to a relatively low proportion in 2004 and 2009. That is to say, from 1978 to 2009, the proportion of Shanghai's manufacturing output value showed opposite changes of a large rise in the suburbs and a large decline in the urban area.
Reasoning: The concentration of the proportion of manufacturing output value toward the suburbs indicates that industrial activities transferred to and agglomerated in the suburbs. Industrial development requires industrial construction land such as factory buildings and industrial parks. The suburbs originally had more agricultural land, so this change can show that part of the suburban agricultural land was transformed into industrial land.
